host.workloadTerm: no agent harness, build, browser, dev server, or any workload started for or during the gate; the host's resident idle login session is part of the environment; enforced by the quantitative envelope terms and recorded by full process snapshot before and after every phase.

envelope.thermal: pmset -g therm: nominal before and after every phase; unknown refuses

samplePolicy: No per-sample exclusions; p99 evidence only; inside-envelope failure final at this head; whole-run invalidity retained, identical-manifest/same-hardware retry only; interrupted state requires reviewed recovery
instrumentOverhead: Native getrusage, owner phase counters, memory/heap observations, GC markers and synchronous record output perturb this instrument; no forced GC
cpuBaseline: Real pre-registry endpoints at baselineHead on the same host and fixture format. Raw guarded server CPU determines acceptance; paired baseline delta is reported separately, including instrument/crypto differences; no head verification bypass.
managedTestAdapter: One shared native flock per fixture; actual public invocation contract; separate wait/hold; not private native journal qualification
crossProcessClock: Native CLOCK_MONOTONIC microseconds encoded as nanoseconds, parent/child bracket verified; never Bun process-relative hrtime
